title: Herbal
description: A set of overworld and nether teas that need a new crop to make. They all grant a different effect custom to the mod changing the user physically.
body:
This mod is entirely meant to add tea and more crops later down the line, as of 1.0.0 there is only tea leaves which are found in jungle biomes. This mod is meant for RP but can be used in anyway you want. If you see text saying something is stronger because of sweetness or bitterness that is a different item not a tag, you can not turn the base tea into the sweet or tart version.

## 1.1 Update
![The icon of the new update for Herbal called the Meeting Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01c96c8f2d010fe4159cbd6864514b19fbb89931.png)
- A complete revamp where all tea is now put into a mug made with brick. I also added 2 new drinks in eggnog and hot cocoa which heal the user, aswell as added a new tea: Chamomile Tea which grants increased entity interaction range until hit.
- The kettle is also new which fills mugs so you can make tea in the world instead of the crafting table _(although you still can if you wish)_.
- Also Flax has been added, a new crop that can be turned into string or turn rotten flesh into leather. Flax will not grow next to water at all. This does not count corners though.
- Tea crop has been reworked aswell completely to have 3 stages and must be in farmland with light, if it is dark it can go backwards in it's growth.
